question:
Sujlam started from a point facing towards the west, turned left and walked for 10 m, then turned right and walked for 12 m, then turned left and walked for 11 m, and then turned left again at point P and walked for 17 m. Prior to turning left at point P, he was facing in which direction?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Drawing a diagram according to the given information,

 
• Sujlam started from a point facing towards the west, turned left and walked for 10 m.
 
• Then turned right and walked for 12 m.
 
• Then turned left and walked for 11 m.&l
